Aakhri do log pul ke beech mein the... aur mashaal bujh gayi.

Interview ka famous puzzle. Raat ka andhera, ek pul. Chaar log, aur sirf ek mashaal... jo bas pandrah minute chalegi. A ek minute mein pul paar karta hai, B do minute, C paanch, aur D aath. Pul par ek baar mein sirf do log. Aur saath chalein, toh dheeme wale ki speed se.
Sabse tez A, sabko chhod aaye? Aath, ek, paanch, ek, do... satrah minute. Mashaal khatam! Toh batao... pandrah minute mein sab kaise paar honge? Teen second... socho.
Trick hai, dono dheemon ko saath bhejo! Pehle A aur B, do minute. A wapas, ek. Ab C aur D saath, aath minute. B wapas, do. Aakhir mein A aur B, do. Theek pandrah minute!
